selection: 8 cells per cell type x assay; fixed random seed, before any model inference
target_selection: 48 coding and 16 lncRNA genes, random from reference-only detection>=10% and nonconstant expression
input_scale: Source X retained, already log1p; counts stored separately; no recomputation of X

completion.normalization: Observed counts only for inputs; full supported measured-gene library for separate scorer truth

denoising.mechanism: Binomial thinning of actual counts, retain probability 0.5
denoising.scope: Native-noise API demo; not OpenProblems benchmark
